title: Nudging Drivers to Safety: Evidence from a Field Experiment
authors: Vivek Choudhary; Masha Shunko; Serguei Netessine; Seongjoon Koo
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment with a single launch date (July 25, 2018) for all three nudge arms (PB, AV, LS); the DiD in Table 5 interacts arm dummies with a common 'after' indicator, so there is one adoption cohort and three simultaneous treatments. The field-experiment data (MS_data.csv) are not shipped.
design_notes: RScript_FieldExpt.R: ols(score ~ nudge arm dummies + nudgeXafter interactions + after [+ controls]) and a driver-FE version (factor(userid) + controls_fe + interactions + after), clustered by userid (Table 5); Table 6 sd of score; Table 7 GRF heterogeneity. main_program.R reproduces the MTurk lab experiment (Tables 8, 9, A3.2) from data_analysis.csv.
data_files_note: Only the MTurk experiment data (data_analysis.csv) are shipped; the field-experiment trip data read by RScript_FieldExpt.R (MS_data.csv, Raxel/J.D. Power app) are absent.
data_provenance_note: DiD (field) data not shipped; shipped MTurk data are original but belong to a separate lab study.
software_notes: R (data.table, custom ols wrapper), with RStata calls for balance tables.
screener_notes: Published PDF text read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2021.4063.txt). Management Science 2022, 68(6):4196-4214. Common start date, so not staggered.
